assets.generationPrompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Make a NEW animation sprite sheet of ELAINA from Wandering Witch, closely based on the attached official character model reference. Identity: long silver-grey hair with small tied sidelocks, violet eyes, oversized floppy charcoal witch hat with pale pink-lavender double ribbon and dangling gold ornament, charcoal-purple LONG open robe with grey lining and pink trim, cream-white blouse, yellow neck ribbon, small gold star witch brooch, dark pleated skirt, dark purple ankle boots with pink details. Faithful face and costume, elegant anime cel shading, clean line art matching official anime. No brown satchel, no brown boots. Non-chibi normal anime proportions.
Exactly EIGHT distinct sequential WALKING poses in a 4-column,2-row regular grid. Read left to right then row2. ALL FACE RIGHT in consistent SIDE PROFILE. Each cell 512x512; canvas2048x1024. All FULL BODY with margins; hat top around y35 and grounded boot soles at y470 within EACH cell; hip center x256. Same head size/body scale and same stable torso center in every frame.
One complete TWO-STEP walk: 1 near/right leg forward heel contact, far/left behind; 2 weight settles on near leg; 3 far leg swings past standing near leg; 4 far leg reaches forward; 5 FAR/left leg forward heel contact with NEAR/right leg now behind; 6 weight settles on far leg; 7 NEAR leg swings past standing far leg; 8 near leg reaches forward completing loop back to1. Eight truly different poses, second half swaps the lead leg. Near limb occludes far limb consistently. Clear moving boots below robe; gently alternating arm swing, restrained cloak/hair follow-through. NO running, no crouching, no duplicate four-pose row. Fixed face/torso orientation. No scenery, labels, grid lines or cast shadows.
CRITICAL: output genuine TRANSPARENT PNG with alpha channel, not a drawn transparency checkerboard. Empty areas must actually be transparent.

generationPrompts:
Use case: illustration-story. Production game sprite sheet of ELAINA from Wandering Witch matching attached official model faithfully: silver-grey long hair/tied sidelocks, violet eyes, charcoal-purple floppy witch hat with pale pink double hatband and hanging gold coin, long charcoal open robe grey lining/pink trim, white blouse yellow neck ribbon and gold star brooch, dark skirt, purple/pink ankle boots. Official-anime clean cel shaded line art, normal anime proportions, no chibi, no brown satchel.
4 columns by 2 rows, 8 equal 512x512 cells on 2048x1024 TRUE transparent RGBA canvas. ALL face RIGHT in SIDE PROFILE. Full hat, hair, boots and broom always fit inside cell with ample margins. Same character/body/head size throughout.
Row1, four subtle idle poses: relaxed standing, slight inhale, relaxed standing with blink, slight exhale. Identical planted feet at x256/y470, hat top y35; feet and head positions nearly stable.
Row2, four broom poses: seated side-on on horizontal wooden broom facing RIGHT, golden bristles on LEFT, handle RIGHT, same seated posture and same pelvis and broom placement in all four. Feet and robe well separated. Pose5 hovering calmly; pose6 slight hair/robe drift; pose7 flight gently leaning forward only a little; pose8 matching gently flowing hair. NO drastic pose change. Entire broom inside cell with at least 20px margin. Standing and seated character's anatomical scale identical; seated poses naturally occupy less height. Render only one character per cell. No labels, words, outlines around cells, shadows, checkerboard or background. TRUE TRANSPARENCY mandatory.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Repair the framing of this transparent Elaina 8-pose game atlas. Keep the SAME eight poses and anime character design, costume, colors. Do NOT change facial design. Keep TRUE RGBA transparency.
Important: shrink EACH figure including broom to 80% of its current size WITHIN its own cell. Uniform 4 columns x 2 rows of EQUAL SQUARE cells. Figure in top row must end BEFORE the row midpoint; currently feet cross into row2. EVERY figure must have at least 30px fully transparent padding on ALL four sides inside its cell. All brooms including the very leftmost straw tips must be entirely inside their cells with padding. Hat top and boots must not be cut off. Standing frames same centered body anchor and sole baseline. Broom frames same centered seat and broom line. Produce correctly spaced sprites, NOT tightly packed figures touching cell boundaries. No checkerboard, no background.

postprocessing.method: rembg isnet-anime CPU segmentation of each pose; transparent lossless WebP sprite sheets; Pillow resampling and packing.
postprocessing.layout: Two 2048×1024 sheets, eight 512×512 cells each. Standing/walk soles aligned at (256,470); body axis estimated from yellow neck ribbon. 430px normalized standing height; broom proportions preserve anatomical scale.
postprocessing.runtime: Phaser textures, independent presentation clock at 10 frames/s at normal walk speed, anchored breathing/stride stretch, physical body updated independently.
